provenance.precalibration_recovery: Initial workflow SHA typo and a false expectation in a pure, noncohort unit test corrected before any source calibration or heldout use; frozen prereg and method unchanged.

source.paired_method: Exact F76 source for seed,family; invert F76 local_rotate4 for odd family or retain original for even family, then apply both F76.shift regimes. The graph's exact public edge multiset, original eventual question and answer remain identical between treatments.

scientific_interpretation.paired_causal_order_effect: For these fixed graphs and questions, changing only the presentation order made 11 four-step cases fail under F60. Original-order F60 wins on every discordant heldout graph. This is a genuine controlled synthetic order effect, not an independent prospective optimizer-performance improvement.
scientific_interpretation.role_of_native_choices: Rotated arrival produces more legal native one-deviation candidates and fewer public join/touch opportunities, but does not improve six-step success. Candidate quantity alone does not imply quality.
scientific_interpretation.bounded_hindsight_feasibility: With eventual question/future/answer revealed to the offline auditor, at most four original-order and three rotated-order six-step cases admitted a one-step rescue among eight. These are not actionable online evidence.
scientific_interpretation.limitations: Both treatments derive from the same frozen F76 generator; this is not a newly independent data-generating mechanism. The public descriptor counters were gathered offline and are not free extra state within 144B. Neither 72-prefix retrospective credit nor matched effect creates a qualified autonomous query-blind controller.
